items.title: Second case against Catholic priest Cyprian Pinto for alleged sexual assault of teen boy
items.summary: A second case has been registered against Father Cyprian Pinto, the parish priest of St Vincent Ferrer Church in Valencia, Mangaluru, over allegations of sexually assaulting a 13-year-old boy, the Mangaluru City Police said on November 9. According to a press release issued by the Mangaluru City Police, the Mangaluru Women Police Station registered the case based on a complaint alleging that Pinto (65) sexually assaulted the boy on May 13, 2026. The boy regularly attended Sunday prayers at St Sebastian Church in Permannur village. The investigation into the second case has been handed over to the Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP), Central Sub-Division, Mangaluru City. Pinto was earlier booked by the Mangaluru South Police Station on October 15 following a complaint alleging sexual harassment of a 14-year-old boy. He was arrested on October 17 and produced before a court on October 18. He was remanded to judicial custody until October 30 and subsequently released on bail. The Additional District and Sessions Judge of the Fast Track Special Court-I in Mangaluru granted Pinto bail on October 29.
